assert.// note: No preset — this is a daily/push perf DASHBOARD, not a merge gate (the job commits scores to docs/lighthouse-scores.json and runs on schedule + push-to-main). The lighthouse:no-pwa preset ships error-level per-audit assertions (errors-in-console, valid-source-maps, legacy-javascript...) that would fail every main push on a healthy site — the exact 'red check everyone ignores' problem #168 fixed. Category scores are warn-level: regressions show in the logs without failing the job. A genuine collect failure (site unreachable) still fails loudly because the step is no longer continue-on-error.
